BC_description: The onFID() function has been removed as it was deprecated. This includes the removal of onFID from the main and attribution exports, FIDThresholds, FIDMetric and related types, and all associated code. This will break any code that still uses this function or its related exports. The removal is part of the v5 branch update, as referenced in the pull request and commit messages.
Adaptation_method: Replace calls to onFID() with onINP() as the recommended alternative for measuring input responsiveness, since FID is deprecated and INP is its successor. Example: Instead of `onFID(callback)`, use `onINP(callback)`.
